rationale: This is effectively the archived "External Debt Reliance of Research Programs" with the NEG removed and dlc dropped, so the archive already reports the answer (the non-negated product earned ~+0.031 alpha at t≈+3.1), making it a sign-flipped rediscovery of the pair's own result rather than a new test.

The organic-minus-acquired leg was already tested against a debt-service *strain* conditioner (gen 2, alpha 0.064, t=4.46) with the same expected positive sign, and the new conditioner is roughly the negative of that strain measure, so the proposal asserts a positive sign for a signal that is largely the reverse of an archived positive result — an internal inconsistency that must be resolved before the recombination is informative.

Reduced to essentials this is a liquidity/inverse-leverage level ratio (current assets over total liabilities) with a modest R&D-stock add-on, which duplicates heavily documented distress/leverage predictors and, as an unranked and unwinsorized raw ratio, will have its Fama-MacBeth slope driven by a handful of tiny-liability outliers rather than by the intangible adjustment the hypothesis is about.

Swapping RANK for TS_RANK on one leg of an archived signal is close to a mechanical variant, and it deletes the cross-sectional intangible-intensity theme altogether, leaving a within-firm investment/financing-expansion timing measure whose expected positive sign runs directly against the well-documented asset-growth and investment anomalies.

NEG(RANK(gdwl))×RANK(strain) is monotonically the exact negative of the gen-0 "Acquired-Intangible Debt Service Gap" (which already delivered −0.044 at t=−3.23), so the outcome is essentially known in advance and, because both legs remain multiplied, it does not isolate the goodwill leg as claimed.

target_name: Revenue Servicing Capacity of Research Firms
rationale: Revenue-to-liabilities is a genuinely different conditioner class from the cash-flow and balance-sheet gates already tried and cleanly separates pre-revenue from commercialized innovators, though it is still a rank product of two individually known predictors (R&D intensity, turnover/inverse leverage) and sits in tension with the archived gross-profit-per-R&D-dollar result that came in negatively signed.
